questions.question: Approve the academy’s name in both occurrences: the source gives USSR Academy of Pedagogical Sciences from 1955, while the pedagogical research library gives the RSFSR academy in 1955, https://dates.gnpbu.ru/0-5/Bradis/bradis.html . Approve the correction in both versions.

localizations.source: Approve the academy’s name in both occurrences: the source gives USSR Academy of Pedagogical Sciences from 1955, while the pedagogical research library gives the RSFSR academy in 1955, https://dates.gnpbu.ru/0-5/Bradis/bradis.html . Approve the correction in both versions.
localizations.ru: Согласовать название академии в двух местах: исходник даёт член-корреспондент АПН СССР с 1955 года, научная педагогическая библиотека указывает АПН РСФСР (1955): https://dates.gnpbu.ru/0-5/Bradis/bradis.html . Утвердить исправление RU/EN.

questions.resolution: Both editions name the RSFSR Academy of Pedagogical Sciences, as recorded by the [Ushinsky Scientific Pedagogical Library](https://dates.gnpbu.ru/0-5/Bradis/bradis.html).

questions.question: Clarify the reprint count: the introduction says over a hundred, while a later paragraph gives about sixty before 1991 and thirty afterwards. Supply the date and basis for the count and distinguish editions, print runs and reprints.

questions.question: Supply the source of Bradis’s epigraph and of the quotation beginning Millions read this little book, attributed only to unnamed contemporaries. Both are retained from the author’s text without invented attribution.
